schedule: serial; each case Qwen then GPT, fresh context/session/history, no coaching or continuation
task: Read every listed source in full, including potential decoys, before proposing. Investigate directed HTTP dependencies. Read the callsite and provider declaration, including decorators. Propose only supported typed claims using evidence_refs returned in this session; finish after supported findings or insufficient evidence. Operator addresses: orders=https://orders.test; status=https://inventory.test. All candidates remain unapproved.

parameters.read_policy: all listed sources fully before first proposal

deadlines.rule: Persist absolute series and case deadlines at first start; timeout=min(60, series_remaining, case_remaining). Checks before reservation, send, every transport stage and admission. Never pause, extend or reset on restart. Any late result is PARTIAL and cannot be admitted.

live_blockers: explicit NEW request/money limit (grant already confirmed)
review and integrate this runner on main; run expected exact main SHA

scoring.transport: HTTP/status/finish_reason/usage, timeout keeps unknown usage; every attempted send consumes a ledger reservation
scoring.protocol: finish within deadline and steps; no invalid action/range/reference
scoring.sufficiency: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_PROFILE including directed consumer/provider identity and covered declarations/callsites
scoring.quality: held-out typed oracle, no forbidden/extra claims and both evidence sides read; report rejected semantic claims too
scoring.success: All four protocol/provenance/sufficiency/quality pass; candidate remains UNAPPROVED_CANDIDATE; no comparison of model superiority from this small corpus

budget.rate_scope: Conservative input+output RUB upper rate, not observed billing; guard only. Both models use the same bound.
budget.new_limit: NOT_YET_AUTHORIZED; initialize requires explicit request/money caps
